direct_phone_captcha.flow: After Discord phone QR approval, HTTP400 CAPTCHA shows second HTTPS QR for phone camera/browser. Static page renders official hCaptcha with exact sitekey/rqdata. User completes challenge and taps Send to Switch. A short-lived private-IP TCP listener receives one encrypted form POST; native decrypt validates 256-bit state and retries the same Discord ticket once with existing rqtoken/session headers.
direct_phone_captcha.transport: WebCrypto AES-256-GCM, random 96-bit IV, 128-bit tag; AES key wrapped using active session RSA-2048 OAEP/SHA256 public key. AAD DiscordNX2 CAPTCHA v1: + state. Envelope version1 + 256-byte RSA + 12-byte IV + ciphertext/tag. Plaintext state + newline + bounded printable token. Local HTTP carries ciphertext only; no ticket, account token, private key or plaintext solution is sent over LAN or hosted on website.
direct_phone_captcha.bounds: Listener binds only existing Discord socket private IPv4 address, random OS port; private-source peers, 150-second total wait, 3-second receive deadline, 8 invalid requests maximum, bounded Content-Length, no transfer-encoding or pipelining, exact POST path. Listener and secrets closed/wiped on success/cancel/error/timeout. QR limited to 2200 bytes; never truncate challenge data.
direct_phone_captcha.hosting: https://gamingwithgoose.github.io/DiscordNX2/verify.html; canonical source docs/verify.html. No relay or external community-site dependency.
direct_phone_captcha.validation: v0.37 canonical docs/verify.html passed actual WebCrypto/mbedTLS interoperability, 2048/4095-byte results, visible oversize errors, fallback callback polling, malformed result rejection and private destination checks. Legacy CAPTCHA page tests and AArch64 strict syntax checks passed. No NRO or dependency build. Live project Pages home/verification files HTTP200 and exact-source verified. User must build NRO and test real phone CAPTCHA/Discord acceptance.
